text.19:64: We (angels) come not down save by commandment of thy Lord. Unto Him belongeth all that is before us and all that is behind us and all that is between those two, and thy Lord was never forgetful -
text.26:210: The devils did not bring it down.
text.26:221: Shall I inform you upon whom the devils descend?
text.26:222: They descend on every sinful, false one.
text.41:30: Lo! those who say: Our Lord is Allah, and afterward are upright, the angels descend upon them, saying: Fear not nor grieve, but hear good tidings of the paradise which ye are promised.
text.65:12: Allah it is who hath created seven heavens, and of the earth the like thereof. The commandment cometh down among them slowly, that ye may know that Allah is Able to do all things, and that Allah surroundeth all things in knowledge.
text.97:4: The angels and the Spirit descend therein, by the permission of their Lord, with all decrees.
